mn152:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kajaṅgalāyaṃ viharati Mukheluvane.
mn152:2.1: Atha kho Uttaro māṇavo Pārāsariyantevāsī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn152:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantam nisinnaṃ kho Uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ Pārāsariyantevāsiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
mn152:2.3: Deseti, Uttara, Pārāsariyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanan ti?
mn152:2.4: Deseti, bho Gotama, Pārāsariyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanan ti.
mn152:2.5: Yathākathaṃ pana, Uttara, deseti Pārāsariyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanan ti?
mn152:2.6: Idha, bho Gotama, cakkhunā rūpaṃ na passati, sotena saddaṃ na suṇāti;
mn152:2.7: evaṃ kho, bho Gotama, deseti Pārāsariyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanan ti.
mn152:2.8: Evaṃ sante kho, Uttara, andho bhāvitindriyo bhavissati badhiro bhāvitindriyo bhavissati,
mn152:2.10: Andho hi, Uttara, cakkhunā rūpaṃ na passati badhiro sotena saddaṃ na suṇātīti.
mn152:2.11: Evaṃ vutte Uttaro māṇavo Pārāsariyantevāsī tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhando adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdi.
mn152:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Uttaraṃ Pārāsariyantevāsiṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhāṇaṃ viditvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn152:3.2: Aññathā kho, Ānanda, deseti Pārāsariyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanaṃ; aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hotīti.
mn152:3.3: Etassa Bhagavā kālo, etassa Sugata kālo,
mn152:3.4: yaṃ Bhagavā ariyassa vinaye anuttaraṃ indriyabhāvanaṃ deseyya. Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
mn152:3.5: Tena h', Ānanda, suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn152:3.6: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn152:4.1: Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hoti?
mn152:4.2: Idh' Ānanda, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati manāpaṃ uppajjati amanāpaṃ uppajjati manāpāmanāpaṃ.
mn152:4.4: Uppannaṃ kho me idaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāpāmanāpaṃ,
mn152:4.5: tañ ca kho saṃkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ paṭicca samuppannaṃ
mn152:4.8: Tassa taṃ uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāpāmanāpaṃ nirujjhati,
mn152:4.10: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, cakkhumā puriso ummīletvā vā nimīleyya nimīletvā vā ummīleyya, --
mn152:4.11: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃ sīghaṃ evaṃ tuvaṭaṃ evaṃ appakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāpāmanāpaṃ nirujjhati upekhā saṇṭhāti.
mn152:4.12: Ayaṃ vuccat', Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu.
mn152:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā uppajjati manāpaṃ uppajjati amanāpaṃ uppajjati manāpāmanāpaṃ.
mn152:5.9: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, balavā puriso appakasirena accharikaṃ pahareyya, --
mn152:5.10: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃ sīghaṃ evaṃ tuvaṭaṃ evaṃ appakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāpāmanāpaṃ nirujjhati upekhā saṇṭhāti.
mn152:5.11: Ayaṃ vuccat', Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā sotaviññeyyesu saddesu.
mn152:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhuno ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā uppajjati manāpaṃ . . .
mn152:6.9: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, īsakapoṇe paduminipatte udakaphusitāni pavattanti na saṇṭhanti,
mn152:6.10: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yassa kassaci . . . saṇṭhāti.
mn152:6.11: Ayaṃ vuccat', Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu.
mn152:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhuno jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā uppajjati manāpaṃ . . .
mn152:7.9: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, balavā puriso jivhagge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saṃyūhitvā appakasirena vameyya, --
mn152:7.10: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yassa kassaci . . . saṇṭhāti.
mn152:7.11: Ayaṃ vuccat', Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu.
mn152:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhuno kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā uppajjati manāpaṃ . . .
mn152:8.9: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya,
mn152:8.10: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yassa kassaci . . . saṇṭhāti.
mn152:8.11: Ayaṃ vuccat', Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu.
mn152:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjati manāpaṃ . . .
mn152:9.9: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, puriso divasaṃ santatte ayothāle dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni nipātteyya,
mn152:9.10: dandho Ānanda, udakaphusitānaṃ nipāto, atha kho taṃ khippam eva parikkhayaṃ pariyadānaṃ gaccheyya, --
mn152:9.11: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yassa kassaci . . . saṇṭhāti.
mn152:9.12: Ayaṃ vuccat', Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā manoviññeyyesu dhammesu.
mn152:9.13: Evaṃ kho, Ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hoti.
mn152:10.1: Kathañ c', Ānanda, sekho hoti pāṭipado?
mn152:10.2: Idh', Ānanda, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati manāpaṃ uppajjati amanāpaṃ uppajjati manāpāmanāpaṃ.
mn152:10.3: So tena uppannena manāpena uppannena amanāpena uppannena manāpāmanāpena aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati.
mn152:10.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjati manāpaṃ uppajjati amanāpaṃ uppajjati manāpāmanāpaṃ.
mn152:10.9: So tena uppannena manāpena uppannena amanāpena uppannena manāpāmanāpena aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati. --
mn152:10.10: Evam eva kho, Ānanda, sekho hoti pāṭipado.
mn152:11-15.1: Kathañ c', Ānanda, ariyo hoti bhāvitindriyo?
mn152:11-15.2: Idh', Ānanda, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati manāpaṃ uppajjati amanāpaṃ uppajjati manāpāmanāpaṃ.
mn152:11-15.3: So sace ākaṅkhati: Paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:11-15.4: Sace ākaṅkhati: Appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:11-15.5: Sace ākaṅkhati: Paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:11-15.6: Sace ākaṅkhati: Appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:11-15.7: Sace ākaṅkhati: Paṭikkūlañ ca appaṭikkūlañ ca tad ubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti, upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
mn152:16.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Ānanda, bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā,
mn152:16.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjati manāpaṃ uppajjati amanāpaṃ uppajjati manāpāmanāpaṃ.
mn152:16.6: So sace ākaṅkhati: Paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:16.7: Sace ākaṅkhati: Appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:16.8: Sace ākaṅkhati: Paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, appaṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:16.9: Sace ākaṅkhati: Appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati.
mn152:16.10: Sace ākaṅkhati: Appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti, paṭikkūlasaññī tattha viharati. Sace ākaṅkhati: Paṭikkūlañ ca appaṭikkūlañ ca tad ubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti, upekhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
mn152:16.11: Evaṃ kho, Ānanda, ariyo hoti bhāvitindriyo.
mn152:17.1: Iti kho, Ānanda, desitā mayā ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā, desito sekho pāṭipado, desito ariyo bhāvitindriyo.
mn152:18.1: Yaṃ kho, Ānanda, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
mn152:18.2: Etāni, Ānanda, rukkhamūlani, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyath', Ānanda, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī ti.
mn152:18.4: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
